pull.title: KAFKA-21194 [2/N]: Register the balanced task assignor as a built-in assignor
pull.body:
Appends `BalancedTaskAssignor` to `GroupCoordinatorConfig`'s list of
built-in streams task assignors, after `StickyTaskAssignor`. The default
of  `group.streams.assignors` becomes `sticky,balanced`, so every broker
registers the balanced assignor without configuration and a group can
select it with `streams.assignor.name=balanced`. The first entry is
unchanged, so groups that do not set `streams.assignor.name` keep using
the  sticky assignor.

`group.streams.assignors` no longer rejects a custom assignor whose name
is the name of a built-in assignor; otherwise a 4.4 broker that
registers a custom streams assignor named `balanced` would fail to start
after upgrading. A custom assignor configured on its own now replaces
the built-in of the same name, as it already does for
`group.consumer.assignors` since KAFKA-20843. Configuring both still
fails the duplicate-name check at startup.

Reviewers: gabriellafu (github:gabriellefu), Lucas Brutschy
 <lbrutschy@confluent.io>

commit.message:
KAFKA-21194 [2/N]: Register the balanced task assignor as a built-in assignor

Appends BalancedTaskAssignor to GroupCoordinatorConfig's list of built-in
streams task assignors, after StickyTaskAssignor. The default of
group.streams.assignors becomes "sticky,balanced", so every broker registers
the balanced assignor without configuration and a group can select it with
streams.assignor.name=balanced. The first entry is unchanged, so groups that
do not set streams.assignor.name keep using the sticky assignor.

The assignor was left unregistered when it was added because its
active-task fix-up loop compared every pair of processes on each pass and
took up to 26 times the sticky assignor's time for 1000 single-member
processes. Active tasks are now placed with the Sainte-Laguë method, which
brings the full assignment for 1000 members and 10,000 tasks to 1.7 ms
without standbys and 4.3-10.2 ms with one standby, against 2.8-3.3 ms and
4.7-5.1 ms for the sticky assignor.

Updates GroupCoordinatorConfigTest for the new default, extends the
streams-group heartbeat test to select the balanced assignor through
incrementalAlterConfigs without any broker configuration, and updates the
streams rebalance protocol docs to describe both built-in assignors.

Let custom streams task assignors reuse built-in assignor names

Registering the balanced assignor as a built-in made "balanced" a reserved
name: group.streams.assignors rejected any custom assignor whose name()
equals the name of a built-in assignor, even when that built-in is not
configured. A 4.4 broker that registers a custom streams assignor named
"balanced" would therefore fail to start after upgrading. The check is
removed, as KAFKA-20843 (#23473) did for group.consumer.assignors, so a
custom assignor configured on its own replaces the built-in of the same
name. The duplicate-name check is kept, so configuring a custom assignor
together with the built-in whose name it reuses still fails at startup.

Moves the check that a group can select the balanced assignor without
broker configuration into its own heartbeat test, which also heartbeats
a member and checks that describeStreamsGroups reports "balanced" as the
group's assignor. Corrects the streams rebalance protocol docs:
rack-aware placement is an assignor feature in the streams protocol,
which neither built-in assignor implements yet.

Add a 4.5.0 upgrade note for custom streams assignor names

Starts the "Upgrading to 4.5.0" section of the upgrade notes with a note
that group.streams.assignors now accepts a custom assignor reusing the
name of a built-in assignor, which then replaces the built-in, so that a
broker registering a custom assignor named "balanced" keeps starting now
that "balanced" is a built-in streams task assignor.

+    val admin = cluster.admin()

+    val topicName = "test-topic"
+

+        controllers = cluster.controllers().values().asScala.toSeq,
+        topic = topicName,
+        numPartitions = 3
+      )
+      TestUtils.waitUntilTrue(() => {
+        admin.listTopics().names().get().contains(topicName)
+      }, msg = s"Topic $topicName is not available to the group coordinator")
+
+      // Every built-in assignor is registered by default, so a group can select the balanced assignor without
+      // any broker configuration.
+      val groupConfigResource = new ConfigResource(ConfigResource.Type.GROUP, groupId)
+      val balancedAlterOp = new AlterConfigOp(
+        new ConfigEntry(GroupConfig.STREAMS_ASSIGNOR_NAME_CONFIG, "balanced"),
+        AlterConfigOp.OpType.SET
+      )
+      admin.incrementalAlterConfigs(
+        Map(groupConfigResource -> List(balancedAlterOp).asJavaCollection).asJava
+      ).all().get()
+
+      TestUtils.waitUntilTrue(() => {
+        streamsGroupHeartbeat(
+          groupId = groupId,
+          memberId = "test-member",
+          rebalanceTimeoutMs = 1000,
+          activeTasks = List.empty,
+          standbyTasks = List.empty,
+          warmupTasks = List.empty,
+          topology = createMockTopology(topicName)
+        ).errorCode == Errors.NONE.code()
+      }, "StreamsGroupHeartbeatRequest did not succeed within the timeout period.")
+
+      // The described assignor is the one the coordinator resolves the group config to, which would be the
+      // default sticky assignor if "balanced" were not registered. Group config propagation is asynchronous,
+      // so wait for it.
+      var assignorName: Optional[String] = Optional.empty()
+      TestUtils.waitUntilTrue(() => {
+        assignorName = admin.describeStreamsGroups(List(groupId).asJava).all().get().get(groupId).assignorName()
+        assignorName == Optional.of("balanced")
+      }, s"Expected the group to report the balanced assignor, but it reported $assignorName.")
+    } finally {
+      admin.close()
+    }
+  }

+## Upgrading to 4.5.0
+
+### Upgrading Servers to 4.5.0 from any version 3.3.x through 4.4.0
+
+### Notable changes in 4.5.0
+
+  * A custom assignor configured in `group.streams.assignors` may now reuse the name of a built-in assignor, and then replaces that built-in; such a configuration used to fail broker startup with a `ConfigException`. This matters because `balanced` is now a built-in streams task assignor that is registered by default (the default of `group.streams.assignors` is now `sticky,balanced`), so a broker that registers a custom assignor named `balanced` keeps starting after the upgrade and keeps using that custom assignor. Configuring a custom assignor together with the built-in whose name it reuses still fails broker startup, because assignor names must be unique. For further details, please refer to [KAFKA-21194](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21194).

A group selects an assignor with the group configuration `streams.assignor.name`.

@@ -61,7 +61,7 @@ The following features are not yet available and should be avoided when using th
 
 * **Topology Updates**: If a topology is changed significantly (e.g., by adding new source topics or changing the number of subtopologies), a new streams group must be created.
 
-* **High Availability Assignor**: The sticky assignor is the only built-in assignor and it does not support rack aware assignment, but a custom assignor registered via `group.streams.assignors` can implement it.
